newsitem.title: USA: Storage Tech to redeem debentures.
newsitem.headline: Storage Tech to redeem debentures.

text.p: Storage Technology Corp said on Wednesday it plans to redeem on January 13, 1997 all of its outstanding 8 percent convertible subordinated debentures due May 31, 2015.
The company said redemption of the 8 percent debentures would reduce its interest expense by approximately $11.6 million per year.

Storage Technology said the redemption price will be 103.2 percent of the principal amount, plus accrued interest for the period from November 30, 1996, to January 13, 1997, for a total redemption price of $1,041.56 per $1,000 principal amount of debentures.
The company had $145.6 million in principal of the 8 percent debentures outstanding, it said.
Any 8 percent debentures not converted on or before January 13, 1997, will be automatically redeemed on that date, after which interest will cease to accrue, the company said.

The 8 percent debentures may be converted into shares of common stock at a conversion price of $35.25 per share of common stock, or approximately 28.369 shares per $1,000 principal amount of the debentures, Storage Technology said.
